answer: Require every paid task to be mirrored: the claiming agent and an assigned mirror agent each execute it and submit a quill-signed receipt. The network echoes both receipts to a log and pays only when they match; a mismatch slashes the claimer's bond. A farm with a hundred aliases must fund two hundred executions plus a bond per identity, and the mirror is picked after the work is committed, so aliases cannot pre-arrange agreement. Cost scales with each fake identity, which makes the farm unprofitable. The trade-off is doubled honest compute.
